title: United States Department of the Treasury Announces Key Nomination
summary: Secretary of the Treasury Scott Bessent announced President Trump's intent to nominate Erin Browne, a PIMCO managing director and portfolio manager, to serve as Under Secretary for International Affairs. The Under Secretary for International Affairs oversees Treasury's international financial policy portfolio. The nomination has not yet been confirmed by the Senate.
key_points: Erin Browne, currently a managing director at PIMCO, is nominated for Under Secretary for International Affairs at Treasury
Prior to PIMCO (joined 2018), she was head of asset allocation at UBS Asset Management and head of macro investments at UBS O'Connor
She also held roles at Point72, Citigroup, Moore Capital Management, Neuberger Berman, and Lehman Brothers
The Under Secretary for International Affairs oversees international financial policy, sanctions, exchange rate matters, and engagement with IMF, World Bank, and G20
Nomination requires Senate confirmation; confirmation timeline is not stated in source
The announcement is dated April 13, 2026, making it a recent development
